Hair Preparation

Please read the booking policies below. Once you agree, you'll continue to the booking calendar to pick your service, date and time.

Booking Policies

Cancellation

A 24-hour notice is required to cancel or reschedule an appointment.

Deposit

A $20 deposit is required. The full balance is paid when you sit in the chair.

Appointments

Books open on the 20th of every month. When booking, select all the add-ons you need.

Late Policy

No late fee. Your appointment is cancelled after 10 minutes, so please be on time.
